payload.text: hv 2026-10-31 13:44Z (in vc's window): 'Go with your recommendations on the FOR hv list.' Not executed: Molt's PATH order (rustup's cargo before Homebrew's) needs a Molt session or hv's hand; vc touches Molt nothing. Every other publish, tag or deploy still waits for hv's word (directive 3).
